app.name: VoiceDeskElectron
turn.empty: Nothing here yet. Hold the button and say something.
err.mic.deniedBody: VoiceDeskElectron needs the microphone to hear you. Turn it on in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
err.mic.noneBody: VoiceDeskElectron could not find an input device. Connect one and try again.
err.emptyBody: The recording was silent. Hold the button and speak.
err.mic.retryBody: Nothing was recorded. Hold the button again and allow access when macOS asks.
